title: Personal Mission Statement
habit: Habit 02 — Begin with the End in Mind
author: Kluivert Manuel Peralta Carrera
headline: CREATE WITH PURPOSE.
KEEP LEARNING.
BUILD A FUTURE THAT REFLECTS WHO I AM.
paragraphs: I want to become a creative, independent and determined person who turns ideas into something meaningful. I want to keep exploring, learning and developing my skills instead of being afraid to try something new or make mistakes.

Technology gives me a way to solve problems, experiment and bring my ideas to life. Creativity allows me to look beyond what already exists and find my own way of doing things. I want to use both to build projects that represent my interests, values and personality.
I also want to stay connected to my roots, appreciate my family and the people who support me, and take care of my well-being while working towards my goals.
I know that progress takes patience, consistency and effort, so I will try to focus on what matters instead of comparing my path with other people's.
principle: My ideas deserve action, and my future deserves intention.
highlights: find my own way of doing things
